tasks.details: Extend `/workspaces/gentoo/root.x86_64/scripts/purple-mcp-converters.sh` with `openapi2mcp()` function. Install tools: `npm install -g openapi-mcp-codegen` or `pip install fastapi-mcp`. Pipeline: (1) Parse OpenAPI spec (YAML or JSON) to identify endpoints, (2) For each endpoint, generate MCP tool with appropriate parameters and descriptions, (3) Generate server stub using fastapi-mcp (Python) or generate TypeScript MCP server, (4) Include authentication handling if spec defines security schemes, (5) Output to `/var/lib/purple/mcp-servers/api-<spec-name>/`. Implement `purplectl convert openapi2mcp <spec.yaml>` command. Handle OpenAPI 3.0 and 3.1.
tasks.testStrategy: Test with public OpenAPI spec (e.g., Stripe API, GitHub API subset), verify endpoint parsing, check MCP server generation, test tool invocation with mock API, validate auth handling

subtasks.title: Implement OpenAPI spec parsing for endpoints and parameters
subtasks.description: Parse OpenAPI 3.0 and 3.1 YAML/JSON specifications to extract endpoints, parameters, request bodies, and response schemas
subtasks.details: Implement spec file loading supporting both YAML and JSON formats. Parse OpenAPI 3.0 and 3.1 structures to extract: (1) all endpoint paths and HTTP methods, (2) path parameters, query parameters, headers, and request bodies, (3) response schemas and status codes, (4) endpoint descriptions and summaries for MCP tool documentation. Use existing tools (yq for YAML, jq for JSON) or Python libraries (pyyaml, json) for parsing. Validate OpenAPI version compatibility and provide clear error messages for unsupported versions. Store parsed data in intermediate format suitable for MCP tool generation.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test with sample OpenAPI 3.0 and 3.1 specs (both YAML and JSON), verify all endpoints extracted correctly, validate parameter parsing completeness, check error handling for malformed specs

subtasks.title: Generate MCP tools with authentication handling for OpenAPI 3.0/3.1
subtasks.description: Transform parsed OpenAPI endpoints into MCP tool definitions with proper authentication scheme support
subtasks.details: For each parsed endpoint, generate MCP tool definition with: (1) tool name derived from operationId or path/method, (2) parameter schema matching OpenAPI parameters (path, query, header, body), (3) description from OpenAPI summary/description fields. Implement authentication handling by parsing securitySchemes section: support API key (header/query/cookie), HTTP (basic/bearer), OAuth2 flows. Generate authentication configuration into MCP server setup. Use openapi-mcp-codegen or fastapi-mcp to scaffold the server code. Generate TypeScript or Python server stub that properly handles tool invocations and forwards to actual API endpoints. Include environment variable references for credentials (API_KEY, OAUTH_TOKEN, etc.).
subtasks.testStrategy: Generate servers for specs with different auth schemes (API key, OAuth2, bearer token), verify tool definitions match OpenAPI parameters, test authentication configuration generation, validate generated server compiles/runs without errors

tasks.title: Add WASM runtime stratum to Quantum.sh BSD layer
tasks.description: Extend Quantum.sh to support Wasmtime/jco WASM runtime as a compatibility stratum alongside FreeBSD support
tasks.details: Modify `/workspaces/gentoo/root.x86_64/scripts/Quantum.sh` to add WASM runtime support. Install Wasmtime: download from https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasmtime/releases, extract to `/opt/wasmtime`, symlink to `/usr/local/bin/wasmtime`. Install jco (JavaScript Component Tooling): `npm install -g @bytecodealliance/jco`. Create function `bootstrap_wasm_runtime()` in Quantum.sh that: (1) Installs Wasmtime, (2) Installs jco, (3) Registers WASM capability in hivemind, (4) Creates wrapper `/usr/local/bin/wasm-run` for easy WASM module execution. Update BSD_STATE_FILE to include wasm_runtime status. Add purplectl command: `purplectl quantum wasm-run <module.wasm>`.
tasks.testStrategy: Install Wasmtime and jco, test running sample WASM module (e.g., hello-world.wasm), verify capability registration, test `purplectl quantum wasm-run`, check integration with existing Quantum.sh health monitoring

subtasks.title: Install Wasmtime and jco tooling for WASM execution
subtasks.description: Download and install Wasmtime runtime from GitHub releases and install jco (JavaScript Component Tooling) via npm to enable WASM module execution capability
subtasks.details: Create installation functions in Quantum.sh: (1) `install_wasmtime()` that downloads the latest Wasmtime release tarball from https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasmtime/releases for the detected architecture (amd64/arm64), extracts to `/opt/wasmtime`, and symlinks `wasmtime` binary to `/usr/local/bin/wasmtime`. (2) `install_jco()` that uses npm to globally install `@bytecodealliance/jco` tooling. Both functions should check if already installed before proceeding, log progress to `/var/log/purple/quantum.log`, and emit events to the ouroboros FIFO. Handle architecture detection similar to the existing `ensure_go()` function pattern.
subtasks.testStrategy: Run `wasmtime --version` to verify installation, run `jco --version` to verify npm package, test `wasmtime run` with a minimal hello-world.wasm module, verify symlink at `/usr/local/bin/wasmtime` points to correct binary

subtasks.title: Implement bootstrap_wasm_runtime() function and register capability
subtasks.description: Add core WASM runtime bootstrap orchestration function to Quantum.sh that coordinates installation, capability registration, and wrapper script creation
subtasks.details: Create `bootstrap_wasm_runtime()` function in Quantum.sh that: (1) Calls `install_wasmtime()` and `install_jco()` with error handling, (2) Registers WASM capability via `register_hivemind_capability "quantum" "wasm-runtime" "wasm_exec,wasi_support,component_model"`, (3) Creates wrapper script `/usr/local/bin/wasm-run` with shebang and logic to execute `wasmtime run "$@"` for simplified invocation, makes it executable. (4) Updates `BSD_STATE_FILE` to append `wasm_runtime=present` or `wasm_runtime=absent` status line. (5) Emits event `BSD_COMPAT|wasm_runtime|ready` to FIFO. Add invocation of `bootstrap_wasm_runtime()` to main() function after step 6 (bsd_pkg_watcher build).
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify capability file exists at `/run/purple/capabilities/quantum.cap` and contains wasm_exec capability, check BSD_STATE_FILE contains wasm_runtime line, verify `/usr/local/bin/wasm-run` exists and is executable, test `wasm-run <module.wasm>` wrapper script execution

subtasks.title: Add purplectl quantum wasm-run command integration
subtasks.description: Extend purplectl quantum plugin to support `purplectl quantum wasm-run <module.wasm>` command for operator-friendly WASM module execution
subtasks.details: Modify `/run/purple/purplectl-plugins/quantum.sh` plugin (created by `wire_purplectl_quantum()` function) to add new case handler for `wasm-run` subcommand. The handler should: (1) Validate that at least one argument (WASM module path) is provided, (2) Check that `/usr/local/bin/wasm-run` exists and is executable, returning error if not, (3) Execute `wasm-run "$@"` passing all remaining arguments, (4) Capture exit code and return it. Also add `wasm-status` case that reports Wasmtime version, jco version, and wasm_runtime status from BSD_STATE_FILE. Update the plugin creation in `wire_purplectl_quantum()` to include these new cases.
subtasks.testStrategy: Run `purplectl quantum wasm-status` and verify output shows Wasmtime and jco versions, run `purplectl quantum wasm-run <test.wasm>` with a sample WASM module and verify execution, test error handling when wasm-run is not installed, verify exit codes are properly propagated
